decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly filling your graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. Utilizing cards like Street Wraith and Architect of Will to cycle through your deck, while also using Grief to disrupt your opponent's hand. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a large number of creatures, with support from cards like Generous Ent and Oliphaunt to give your creatures additional abilities. With the help of Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, you can quickly set up the combo and take control of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cascade abilities to quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful spells, creatures, and value. By casting spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cascade into key cards like Crashing Footfalls and Scion of Draco to create a strong board presence. Subtlety can be used to disrupt opponents' strategies while Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding protect your creatures and spells. The deck aims to be aggressive and efficient in its plays, aiming to outpace and overpower opponents in a fast-paced game.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana to quickly ramp into Primeval Titan and search for key lands such as Urza's Saga, Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, and The One Ring. The deck aims to assemble the right combination of lands to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures, land triggers, and even potential combo finishes with Kessig Wolf Run. The deck's synergy between bounce lands, utility lands, and the Amulet of Vigor allows for explosive and powerful plays to outmaneuver opponents and secure victories.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently to play Primeval Titan and combo off with Amulet of Vigor. The deck utilizes land tutors like Expedition Map and Summoner's Pact to find key lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The combination of cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and The One Ring allow for explosive plays and enable the deck to win the game quickly. The deck also includes utility lands and bounce lands to provide additional value and flexibility.

This deck focuses on quickly playing multiple spells in a turn to trigger cascading effects and overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creatures. By utilizing cards with cascade mechanics, such as Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck is able to cheat out big threats like Scion of Draco and Crashing Footfalls. The deck also includes spells like Subtlety and Force of Negation to control the board and protect its creatures. Leyline cards and Leyline Binding help support the deck's aggressive strategy while providing additional benefits.

The deck focuses on cycling through your creatures with cards like Subtlety, Generous Ent, and Architects of Will to quickly fill your graveyard. Once you have enough creatures in your graveyard, you can use cards like Violent Outburst or Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming your opponent with a sudden army of creatures. This combo strategy allows you to quickly swing the game in your favor and finish off your opponent before they have a chance to recover.

The deck revolves around cycling powerful creatures and using cards like Violent Outburst to cascade into Living End, allowing you to bring all of your cycled creatures back onto the battlefield. The key strategy is to stall the game with disruptive creatures like Architects of Will and Grief, while generating advantage with Curator of Mysteries and Waker of Waves. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a board full of high-powered creatures while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Negation. Boseiju, Who Endures can also help ensure your key spells resolve.

The deck focuses on aggressive and efficient creature plays, utilizing a diverse array of creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The addition of Jegantha as a companion adds a unique element to the deck, allowing for additional consistency and flexibility in gameplay. The deck also includes a mix of powerful removal spells and tribal synergies, creating a strong and versatile aggro strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the diverse color requirements of the deck, ensuring that the aggressive tempo is maintained throughout the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing cascade effects to cast powerful spells for free while overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupting their game plan. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats such as Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Brazen Borrower and Force of Negation. By utilizing the synergy between cascade cards and powerful spells, the deck looks to close out games swiftly and decisively.

This deck focuses on quickly getting out powerful creatures and disrupting the opponent with cascade spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can easily cascade into Crashing Footfalls to create a swarm of 4/4 beasts. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect your creatures and disrupt opponents' strategies. With a mix of creatures, removal spells, and cascade effects, this aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.

This aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a combination of cascade spells and powerful creature cards. By utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cast spells for free, the deck aims to flood the battlefield with aggressive threats such as Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent. The addition of disruptive cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation helps to control the game while the Leyline Binding and Tishana's Tidebinder provide additional support. Teferi, Time Raveler is included to disrupt the opponent's strategy, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive tempo and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly cheating powerful creatures like Griselbrand into play from the graveyard using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Fallaji Archaeologist. It utilizes cards that can disrupt opponents' plans like Grief and Tainted Indulgence while also providing card advantage with Faithful Mending. The deck also has a mix of interaction and protection with cards like Solitude and Thoughtseize. By effectively reanimating creatures and disrupting opponents, the deck aims to win through a fast and powerful combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. By playing powerful creatures like Ragavan and Kroxa early on and removing threats with cards like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the game and deal damage efficiently. Additionally, cards like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker disrupt the opponent's strategy while providing additional benefits. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy, with a mix of lands to ensure consistent access to both colors of mana.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and dealing direct damage to the opponent through spells such as Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames. It aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently by utilizing creatures with high power and toughness. The mana base is designed to support a 4-5 color strategy, allowing for flexibility in casting spells of different colors. The deck also includes Leyline cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan and give the player an advantage.

The deck focuses on ramping quickly into powerful land combos to generate massive amounts of mana and consistently play large threats like Primeval Titan. The goal is to tutor for key pieces such as The One Ring and Urza's Saga to create overwhelming board presence and win conditions. The synergy between lands like Simic Growth Chamber and bounce lands allows for explosive turns and the ability to search for utility lands like Bojuka Bog or Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the necessary pieces for a lethal combo finish.

The deck focuses on utilizing flicker effects and efficient creatures to generate value and tempo advantages over the opponent. By repeatedly blinking creatures like Eternal Witness, Coiling Oracle, and Ice-Fang Coatl with cards such as Soulherder and Ephemerate, the deck can outvalue the opponent and control the board. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Deputy of Detention and Skyclave Apparition to handle opposing threats, while cards like Teferi, Time Raveler provide disruption and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and value.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities to create powerful combos and outvalue opponents. It utilizes cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Chord of Calling to search for key creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Blood Artist to generate value and drain opponent's life points. Additionally, the inclusion of various utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth helps to support the deck's toolbox strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful equipment combo using Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to cheat in big artifact creatures like Kaldra Compleat and Inkmoth Nexus. The goal is to quickly equip Colossus Hammer and Shadowspear to create lethal damage potential in a single turn. The deck also utilizes cards like Esper Sentinel and Urza's Saga to generate card advantage and tutor for key pieces, while also utilizing the mana efficiency of Springleaf Drum. With the ability to quickly set up a powerful board state, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a lethal combo finish.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent. With efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, it aims to control the board and protect its threats with countermagic such as Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck also includes efficient card draw and manipulation with Mishra's Bauble, Expressive Iteration, and Preordain to help maintain pressure and find key cards. The mana base provides a good balance of lands that support both the aggressive and control elements of the deck.
